name: flaggems_fractional_max_pool2d
description: Extracted from FlagGems fractional_max_pool2d. Applies 2D fractional max pooling with shared _random_samples so the pooling regions are deterministic, returning (output, indices). Reference upcasts the input and the random samples to float64, mirroring the FlagGems internal double-precision interval computation.
reference:
import torch


def run_correctness(inp, kernel_size, output_size, random_samples):
    out, indices = torch.nn.functional.fractional_max_pool2d(
        inp.float(),
        kernel_size=kernel_size,
        output_size=tuple(output_size),
        return_indices=True,
        _random_samples=random_samples.float(),
    )
    return out.to(inp.dtype), indices


def run(inp, kernel_size, output_size, random_samples):
    del random_samples
    return torch.nn.functional.fractional_max_pool2d(
        inp,
        kernel_size=kernel_size,
        output_size=tuple(output_size),
    )


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    import torch

    inp_shape = ctx["inp__shape"]
    inp_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["inp__dtype"])
    N, C = inp_shape[0], inp_shape[1]
    inp = torch.randn(inp_shape, dtype=inp_dtype, device=device)
    # torch.rand (uniform [0,1)) in float32, shared by candidate and reference.
    random_samples = torch.rand(N, C, 2, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    return {"inp": inp, "random_samples": random_samples}
